ios.ascAppId: YOUR_ASC_APP_ID — App Store Connect > App > General > App Information > Apple ID (numeric, e.g. 1234567890)
ios.appleTeamId: YOUR_TEAM_ID — developer.apple.com > Membership > Team ID (10-char alphanumeric, e.g. AB12CD34EF)

android.serviceAccountKeyPath: ./google-service-account.json — Google Play Console > Setup > API access > Service account > Download JSON key
